subtitle: Start with one situation today: what children can practice, what adults need to do, and how to handle difficulties together.
intro: Before you begin: ages, responsibilities, and evidence
search: Search problems, actions, or entry IDs
placeholder: For example: homework, media, bullying, P01
filterNote: Filters apply only to age and problem entries. The child pages, worksheets, and sources remain available. Printing temporarily opens the whole guide and then restores your filters.
empty: No matching entries. Try fewer keywords or clear the filters.
noScript: Scripts are disabled. Search and filters are unavailable, but you can still open and read each entry.
selfcheck: Parent reflection: choose one change, not a score
ageNote: One entry per age: focus, both roles, situations, and a small practice. These are not annual pass marks.
problemNote: Stable IDs make discussion and revision easier. Priority is not an evidence rating.
childNote: You can have feelings and boundaries while learning to care for yourself and respect others. You have the right to ask for help.
templateNote: Copy onto paper or print. These are practical tools, not diagnostic or rating scales.
sourceNote: Source review date: 2026-10-26. Translation date: 2026-10-27. These translated editions preserve the original source scope and are not local legal or clinical adaptations. Source links do not mean independent expert review has taken place.
books: Further reading: understanding, not proof of effectiveness
credit: The organization draws on the situation index, effort notes, and source explanations in HowToLiveBetter. The guide text, examples, and interface were written independently; the referenced project does not endorse this guide. The CC BY 4.0 notice applies to the referenced project’s text only.
revision: For revisions, identify the entry ID, the specific issue, and reliable sources. Preserve IDs and record changes. New quantitative claims need the population, outcome, and limitations; untested exercises must remain clearly labeled suggestions.
offline: Offline reading; no personal data collected. External source links require internet access.
rebuild: To rebuild with Node.js, run node tools/build.cjs. No additional dependencies are required. Edit data/guide.json and data/ui.json, then rebuild HTML, Markdown, and source notes together.
contents: 18 age entries · 42 problem entries · 6 child pages · 6 worksheets · 25 sources
files: Each package is independent. Open index.html in a browser after extracting the ZIP. The JSON files are the editable content source. The Chinese original has not been changed.
change: Added the complete English edition, including navigation, both roles, child pages, worksheets, source scopes, and offline search.
